title: Execrable
summary: EX'ECRABLE, adjective [Latin execrabilis. See Execrate.] Deserving to be cursed; very hateful; destable; abominable; as an execrable wretch.

inlines.v: EX'ECRABLE, adjective [Latin execrabilis. See Execrate.] Deserving to be cursed; very hateful; destable; abominable; as an execrable wretch.
